stack.api: FastAPI uvicorn on :8000. Launch (start_stack.sh): .venv/bin/uvicorn server.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips 127.0.0.1, started inside `systemd-run --user --scope --unit=helpotron-uvicorn -p MemoryMax=10G -p MemoryHigh=10G -p MemorySwapMax=0`, stdout -> /tmp/helpotron_api.log. Alternate native launch ./deploy/run_native.sh (python3 -m uvicorn server.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000, runs both API+web dev servers). deploy/helpotron.service is the VPS/systemd path: uvicorn server.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --workers 4. Other ports: scrape sidecar :9778 (config.py SCRAPE_SIDECAR_URL), docker maps 8000:8000.
stack.web: Vite. Dev: cd web && npm run dev (vite.config.js server.port=5173, host true, proxies /api /uploads /privacy-policy /extension-guide -> http://127.0.0.1:8000). Build: npm run build -> dist/. Serve: start_stack.sh runs `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173` (vite.config.js preview.port=5173 with the same /api proxy to :8000); cloudflared tunnel -> https://helpotron.dpdns.org points at this :5173 preview. CORS origins include http://localhost:5173, http://127.0.0.1:5173, chrome-extension://*.
stack.db: Prod SQLite: /home/roni/Roni_workspace/helpotron/data/db/helpotron.db (repo .env DATABASE_URL=sqlite:////home/roni/Roni_workspace/helpotron/data/db/helpotron.db; same pin in deploy/run_native.sh). Test isolation: server/tests/conftest.py sets os.environ['DATABASE_URL']='sqlite:///./test_helpotron.db' (plus OMNIROUTE_API_BASE=http://localhost:9, DATA_LAKE_DIR=tempdir+rebind, ratelimiter/auth_limiter resets, per-test datalake monkeypatch) BEFORE any server.* import — the engine binds process-globally at first import of server.database (database.py create_engine(config.database_url)). Root tests/*.py self-pin at module top before their own server.* imports (sqlite:///./test_idor.db, ./test_privacy.db, ./test_rate_limiting.db, tempfile.mkstemp for turnin). README also documents ENVIRONMENT=development DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///./test_helpotron.db" pytest server/tests/ -q. *.db / *.db-shm / *.db-wal are gitignored. NEVER run un-pinned against the prod DB.
stack.docker: docker-compose.yml targets: `docker compose up -d postgres helpotron-api` (or `docker compose up --build -d`). Compose requires (:? guards) JWT_SECRET, SESSION_SECRET, POSTGRES_PASSWORD; API gets DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg2://helpotron:...@postgres:5432/helpotron + POSTGRES_* env; services: helpotron-api (build ., ports 8000:8000, depends_on postgres healthy, volumes helpotron_uploads/helpotron_exports/helpotron_lake) and postgres (postgres:16-alpine, pg_isready healthcheck, volume postgres_data). NOTE: this box's live stack is NATIVE (start_stack.sh / run_native.sh, sqlite), not docker — docker is the alternate/cloud target. Docker CLI here needs `sg docker -c` (memory: docker-access-via-sg).
stack.session-restore: uvicorn reload wedge recipe (memory uvicorn-reload-wedge): symptom — :8000 still LISTENs but every route times out (curl 000; direct, vite proxy, and tunnel all dead) after a touch-triggered reload under the ~90/min monitor-poll flood; the reload socket hand-off races the monitor traffic. Apply: kill the reloader parent (pgrep -af uvicorn / ps -o ppid), wait for :8000 to free, relaunch with the exact start_stack flags (`.venv/bin/uvicorn server.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips 127.0.0.1 >> /tmp/helpotron_api.log 2>&1` via Bash run_in_background — plain nohup is denied in this session's sandbox). Recovery check: curl -m 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/public-config. Gotcha: editing .env alone never triggers reload — must `touch server/main.py` (or restart). start_stack.sh itself is idempotent on re-run via `systemctl --user is-active --quiet helpotron-uvicorn.scope`.
